# Start here: welcome to Dopbase Discussions

Welcome to Dopbase Discussions.

This is where you can get help, suggest improvements, and share how you use Dopbase.

New here? Follow these guides in order. Each includes commands, terminal output, and a way to check the result:

1. [Install Dopbase and claim your local server](https://github.com/dopbase/dopbase/discussions/61).
2. [Import a `.env` file and run your app](https://github.com/dopbase/dopbase/discussions/62).
3. [Configure Dopbase: servers, CLI connections, and defaults](https://github.com/dopbase/dopbase/discussions/63).

Ask setup questions in [Help & questions](https://github.com/dopbase/dopbase/discussions/categories/q-a). Use [Feature requests](https://github.com/dopbase/dopbase/discussions/categories/ideas) for missing capabilities and [Feedback](https://github.com/dopbase/dopbase/discussions/64) for things that worked well or felt confusing. Share your projects and workflows in [Showcase](https://github.com/dopbase/dopbase/discussions/categories/show-and-tell). [General](https://github.com/dopbase/dopbase/discussions/categories/general) is for introductions and project conversations.

Found a reproducible bug? [Open an issue](https://github.com/dopbase/dopbase/issues/new/choose) with the steps to reproduce it. Report vulnerabilities through [our private security process](https://github.com/dopbase/dopbase/security/policy).

Keep secrets, tokens, and private service details out of posts and screenshots. Our [code of conduct](https://github.com/dopbase/dopbase/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) applies here.

We check discussions on Tuesdays and Fridays. When asking for help, include your Dopbase version, operating system, and what you have already tried. This is a community support schedule, not a guaranteed response time.
